summary: The note describes how InspirePay Corp, a Canadian fintech company, overhauled its travel and expense policies as of October 1, 2023 to simplify expense reporting. Key changes include a real-time mobile app, an integrated approval workflow, automated reimbursement within 72 hours, and international expense features. A December 10, 2023 survey found 94% of employees reported increased satisfaction.
one_line: InspirePay Corp's new mobile app and expense policies speed up reporting, approvals and reimbursements, with 94% of employees reporting higher satisfaction.
key_facts: InspirePay Corp is an emerging fintech company from Canada that implemented new travel and expense policies as of October 1, 2023.

Jessica Morales, InspirePay Corp's Chief Financial Officer, discussed the new approach in an interview on November 15th 2023, saying "We have long believed that employees are our most precious resource."
InspirePay Corp launched its real-time expense reporting mobile app on September 20, 2023, letting employees snap receipt photos, classify and submit expenses from a smartphone.
David Tran, a project manager at InspirePay Corp, called the app "truly revolutionary" and said it lets him manage expense reports on the road.
Employees can use the app to view submission status, access historical expense reports and gain insight into their spending patterns.
The app's integrated approval workflow sends supervisors instant alerts on new expense reports, and they can approve or flag reports from their devices.
Algorithms in the approval workflow detect anomalies or policy breaches based on pre-set company parameters.
Before the overhaul, InspirePay Corp reimbursements could take two weeks or longer; now an automated clearing function linked to payroll delivers reimbursements within 72 hours.
Anne Patel, a sales director who travels frequently, said faster reimbursements have been an incredible boost for team morale.
The mobile app now includes currency conversion and categorization options that comply with different tax laws and regulations.
InspirePay Corp provides a helpline and service desk for finance-related queries and trained all staff on managing and reporting expenses.
Survey results released December 10, 2023 showed 94% of InspirePay Corp employees reported increased satisfaction with the expense reporting process.
Robert Clarkson, a senior developer at InspirePay Corp, said expense report day is no longer a worry and he has his weekends back.
